$comment: Surfaces of agenticincome.ai that already work and must be evolved, not replaced. Enforced by scripts/governance/surface-guard.mjs, which reads this file from the base branch. A change needs a Surface change brief that says how every job survives ("job: explanation"); `rearchitect` changes and `locked` surfaces also need Frank's surface-approved label, re-applied after new commits. The gates themselves are a built-in locked surface. Add a surface when a page proves its value; remove one only with Frank's word. Estate view: starlight graph/protected-surfaces.graph.json.

surfaces.why: The compressed expression of Agentic Income: who it is for, what is proven, and honest numbers about what agents earn. The income figures come from data/income-models.json, so it is part of the page's income truth. A narrower rewrite that passes its own tests can still erase it (the frankx.ai homepage was replaced exactly that way on 2026-08-27).

Where a reader decides to buy the pack or an offer. The offer catalog (lib/offers.ts), the pack terminal, the checkout buttons and the checkout route decide what is sold and for how much, so they are part of the surface. Every claim and price here is reviewed; a rewrite that changes the offer is a business decision, not a refactor.
